question: Can the 2009 Abra–Ilocos Sur edible-fauna paper be safely re-verified from an independent primary full-text source after its publisher PDF link began serving unrelated content?

source.citation: Segismundo, A. B., & Felicitas, A. B. (2009). The Edible Fauna of Some Rivers in Abra and Ilocos Sur. UNP Research Journal, XVIII, 15–26.

queries: The Edible Fauna of Some Rivers in Abra and Ilocos Sur Segismundo PDF
Segismundo Baay River Malanas Tineg fish species 2009
The Edible Fauna of Some Rivers in Abra and Ilocos Sur independent full text
Segismundo Felicitas UNP Research Journal volume 18 2009
candidateHostsReviewed: Philippine E-Journals article and issue records
University of Northern Philippines public research pages
author-profile search result (not treated as a verified primary full-text archive)
searchScope.scopeLimit: Bounded public web search only; this does not establish that no independent copy exists. No login, account, or download was used.

findings: The safe Philippine E-Journals article record exposes the title, authors, 2009 issue metadata, and abstract; it does not expose the full article tables in the reviewed page.
The publisher's direct PDF URL was observed in the live browser to serve unrelated gambling/SEO content. Do not open or rely on that live URL until the publisher confirms and repairs it.

Search-engine results still expose cached or indexed text that resembles the original article. Because that text is not an independently verified copy and the publisher link is compromised, it was not used to verify any table or taxon string.

The bounded search found no independently hosted, trusted primary full-text copy. A third-party author-profile result listed the article but did not establish a safely verifiable authorized full-text source.

disposition.priorReview: The 2026-10-30 review remains a record of the earlier source review, but its PDF link requires renewed provenance verification before any table-level work resumes.
disposition.taxa: Keep all proposed paper-derived taxa held; do not transcribe or normalize names from cached snippets.
disposition.approvedUse: Safe index metadata and abstract may support bibliographic study-context summaries with attribution; they do not support species-by-river rows.

nextAction: Seek a publisher-confirmed repaired copy or a verifiable copy from UNP, the authors, or the National Museum. Before resuming table review, confirm file provenance, compare the article pages against the citation, inspect page images, and re-check item-specific reuse terms. Continue with independent, dated river and coastal evidence in the meantime.

sources.supports: Safe public article metadata and abstract for the 2009 paper.
Journal issue metadata and table-of-contents entry naming the article and authors.
Previously cataloged publisher PDF target; current live response was observed to serve unrelated gambling/SEO content and is explicitly excluded from this follow-up.
Bounded search for a public institutional copy; no verified full-text copy was found in the reviewed public results.
